entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for an order I placed a few weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's for a helmet I bought.
Got it, I have the order pulled up now. Before we proceed, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. The helmet itself seems great for safety, but the color isn't quite what I expected. The box is still unopened, I haven't even tried it on.
I understand completely, sometimes the color on the screen can look a little different. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for waiting. I see here in our system that we have a 90-day return window for standard items. Your delivery date was 20 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe. I can approve this return right now.
That's good to hear. Now, just a thought to save us both the hassle of shipping... would you be willing to offer a small partial credit? Say, 20%? I might just keep it if we can make a deal.

That's a reasonable question, but unfortunately, our system isn't set up for partial refunds on preference-based returns. The best and only option I can provide is a full refund once we receive the item back. It ensures you get all your money back.
Alright, a full return it is then. Since I'm going through the process, could you perhaps offer a discount code for my next purchase? I still need a helmet, just in a different color.

I appreciate you asking, but discount codes aren't something I can generate for a standard return process. However, I have just emailed you the prepaid return label. Just attach it to the box and drop it off, and we'll handle the rest.
Okay, that's fair. I've got the email. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with at VeloFit today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
